_comment: Settings for Blind TDD Agent #3 (arbiter). Ruling-only agent. Read-only access to task spec, public_api.md, the specific disputed test, and the challenge text. No Bash, no Edit. Write is allowed SO THE ARBITER CAN EMIT ITS MANDATED ruling — the path guard scopes it to rulings/** and denies writing any sealed test file. Edit/NotebookEdit stay denied. MCP tools (mcp__*) are denied by the path guard while a session is armed: an MCP server is a second filesystem and shell. PowerShell is denied alongside Bash.
